items.title: AnyAPI / Google Search
items.description: Run a Google web search and get the organic results (title, link, snippet, position) as clean JSON. Returns about 10 results per call - Google stopped honoring bulk result counts in September 2025, so a limit above 10 is accepted but returns no more than a page. Send page 2, 3, ... to walk further, or use google.search_100 for up to 100 ranked results in one call, which is cheaper past roughly 20 results. **Price:** \$0.40 per 1,000 requests (flat per request - same cost regardless of results returned). **Routing:** 4 independent lanes are available in execution order. A failed attempt uses the next lane only when the request's payment authorizes that lane's price; the normalized schema stays the same. **Catalog:** [Google Search pricing and uptime](https://getanyapi.com/api/google/search) - live USD price, lane routing, and measured 30-day uptime. [Every Google endpoint](https://getanyapi.com/api/google).

parameters.name: autocorrect
parameters.description: Toggle Google spelling autocorrect (default true). Set false to search the exact query without correction.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Deprecated: send page instead. A continuation token from an earlier response's nextCursor is still accepted and still continues on the source that issued it; page is ignored when cursor is sent alongside it.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Two-letter country code for result localization (e.g. us, gb, de).

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Two-letter interface and results language code (e.g. en, es, de).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of organic results to return in this response. Google stopped honoring bulk result counts in September 2025, so one page is about 10 results and a limit above 10 is accepted but will not return more than that. To go deeper, send page (about 10 results per page, each billed as a request) or use google.search_100, which returns up to 100 ranked results in a single call for one flat charge and is cheaper past roughly 20 results. Price is flat per request.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Fine-grained location to localize results to, more specific than the country-level gl. Send it as an Active Canonical Name from Google's geo-target list: place, then each parent region, then country, with no space after each comma, e.g. 'New York,New York,United States', 'Austin,Texas,United States', 'London,England,United Kingdom'. Common variations are translated to that name when they point to exactly one place: spaces after commas, missing accents, a US state abbreviation ('Orlando, FL, U...

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which page of about 10 organic results to return, starting at 1. Send page 2, 3, ... to walk deeper; each page is billed as one request and any source can serve any page. Replaces cursor.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The Google search query.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Restrict results to a recent time window: 1h, 1d, 7d, 1y, or all. Default all (no time restriction).

items.title: Cloro / Google SERP with organic results, People Also Ask and local pack
items.description: Returns a parsed Google SERP for a keyword from a chosen country: organic results with sitelinks, People Also Ask, related searches, local pack, knowledge graph, shopping cards and sponsored ads. Cloro bills 5 credits for page 1 and 2 more for each extra page, up to 10 pages (23 credits). looot holds the credits for the pages asked at $0.0008 each and settles at the exact charge Cloro reports. A failed extraction is not charged.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Device the search runs from. Defaults to desktop.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Result geography as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Example: "US"

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Interface language as a Google hl code, for example en, de or pt-BR. Overrides the language derived from the country. Example: "en"

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optional response formats.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Google canonical location name, City,Region,Country. Use with a country for city-level results. Not together with uule. Example: "New York,New York,United States"

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: Result pages to scrape, 1 to 10. Each page after the first costs 2 more credits at Cloro.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The keyword to search on Google. Example: "best running shoes"

parameters.name: uule
parameters.description: Pre-encoded Google UULE location string. Not together with location.

items.title: DataForSEO / Google organic results (advanced)
items.description: Returns Google's organic results for a keyword, live: the full result page with snippets, featured blocks and ads. Send tasks, a list of task objects each with keyword, location_name and language_code. Results come back in the same call; the charge follows DataForSEO's reported cost.

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: one task object per request; DataForSEO takes an array at the body root Required by DataForSEO: send one of location_name / location_code / location_coordinate; send one of language_name / language_code.

items.title: Scrape Creators API / Search
items.description: Performs a Google search and returns organic results with url, title, and description for each result. Supports an optional region parameter (2-letter country code) to get localized results from a specific country. Pages 1 through 11 are supported; requests for page 12 or greater return a 400 response.

items.title: SearchApi / Google search results
items.description: Searches Google. Send q; location, gl, hl, device, time_period and page refine it. Returns organic_results, ads, knowledge graph and other result blocks. Charged per search, also when no results come back. Send one of: q, kgmid.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Fixed to "google" for this endpoint. Example: "google"

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Example: "uk"

parameters.name: lr
parameters.description: Example: "lang_en|lang_de"

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Example: "trains from London to Manchester"
